Descriptions.ShortDescription: Live plate-solve polar alignment with a Polar-Align-Pro-style bullseye, optional knob guidance, and smart phone or tablet web page monitor and control.
Descriptions.LongDescription: Polar alignment from real plate solves, no view of the pole needed. Find Axis slews the mount in RA (with safety limits and a confirmation) and takes three frames to find the RA axis; Live View then solves continuously and shows a bullseye with up/down and east/west arrows, and an ALIGNMENT GOOD ENOUGH / EXCELLENT verdict. An optional one-time knob calibration turns the error into tics, turns or degrees of knob rotation. Works in the northern and southern hemisphere. Night-friendly red/green/white display, and an optional smart-phone or tablet web page to run it from your phone on the same network. Developed with AI assistance (Claude); maintained by GRM.
